field.name: Model
field.nameHint: 1–64 characters: letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen
field.label: Label
field.apiBaseHint: Must start with https:// (except the metering proxy's ChatGPT entry, http://metering-proxy:8445/chatgpt/<account>); leave empty for the upstream default endpoint
field.apiKeyHint: The upstream service's key, stored on the gateway and never shown here.
field.apiKeyKeep: Leave empty to keep the saved upstream key.

dialog.priceUnit: Prices are in USD per million tokens, the same unit the table shows.
dialog.selectableNeedsPrice: Offering needs both input and output prices above 0; an unpriced model silently disables a project's budget brake.

caution.title: Before you change {name}
caution.roles: {name} runs these platform roles: {roles}. Pausing or deleting it is refused until they point at another model; an edit here changes them too.

delete.title: Delete model
delete.body: Delete “{name}”? The gateway stops routing it immediately, and this cannot be undone.

block.title: Block model
block.body: Block “{name}”? Once blocked it leaves the selector, and projects pointing at it are refused.

unblock.title: Unblock model
unblock.body: Unblock “{name}”? If it is priced it returns to the selector.

budget.label: Limits
budget.summary: {projects} projects, {withKey} with a key, {over} over budget, {unlimited} unlimited

dialog.title: Set the budget cap
dialog.hint: The default brake is derived from credits ({derived}); entering a number overrides it on the gateway at once, and leaving it empty clears the override.

source.capOver: Cap reached; the gateway refuses calls
source.testSoon: Testing a source needs the conformance suite, which hasn't shipped yet

field.orderHint: 1–100. Lower is tried first; equal priorities share the traffic.
field.upstreamHint: The upstream's own model name, such as kimi-k3; the gateway adds the protocol prefix.
field.apiBaseKeep: Leave empty to keep the saved upstream address.
field.freeHint: The upstream doesn't charge per token (a free model, a flat subscription): input and output are priced at 0, which is not the same as unpriced.
field.zeroNeedsFree: Input and output both at 0 is a free source: turn on Free source. A free source's input and output prices can only be 0.
field.spendCapHint: The most this upstream model may be charged in total, across every source on it: once the gateway's own ledger reaches it, calls are refused. Saving it here sets it on every runtime source on the same upstream. Leave empty for no cap.
field.existingHeaders: Current: {names} (values aren't shown; setting them again replaces the whole set)
field.headerInvalid: A header name or value isn't valid: authentication and transport headers can't be set per source, and values can't contain line breaks.
field.sessionHint: For upstreams that route or cache by conversation (such as x-opencode-session): the gateway puts Claude Code's conversation id in this header. Leave empty to send none.
field.leadsWarning: This priority puts the new source ahead of every source in use, taking their traffic (a source with no priority is only used when every source with one is unavailable).
field.fallback: It goes after the existing sources as a fallback: it is used only when the ones ahead are unavailable.
field.mixedFree: This model will have both free and paid sources: it is billed at the paid price, traffic on the free source included.
field.headersPublic: Header values aren't secret: unless the name contains key, token, secret, auth, password, credential or cookie, any caller holding a project key can read them from the gateway. Put the upstream API key in the upstream key field.
field.needsPrices: Write both an input and an output price (one of them may be 0, such as a transcription model's output): the platform bills all of a model's usage by them. For an upstream that charges nothing, turn on Free source.
field.priceCleared: A price this source has can be changed, not cleared.

delete.title: Delete source
delete.body: The {source} source of {name} will be removed from the gateway, and no more requests go there. If it's the last one, the model goes too.

block.title: Pause source
block.body: Once paused, the gateway stops sending requests to the {source} source of {name}; the model's other sources keep working.

unblock.title: Resume source
unblock.body: Once resumed, the gateway sends requests to the {source} source of {name} again, by priority.

priceChange.title: Change the prices of {name}
priceChange.effect: From now on all usage of {name} is charged at the new prices.

roles.hint: The jobs the platform runs on a model it picks itself. A change applies at once, with no redeploy; a project's own default model and subagent default still win in that project.
roles.unset: Not set: falls back to the project's default model
roles.loadFailed: Couldn't load the platform model roles

notice.set: {role} now points at the chosen model
